[[Erasklion the Prolific]] is a [[Fungal Bloom]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Heart of the Shiverpeaks}}, first level.

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Aria of Zeal}}
*{{skill icon|Ballad of Restoration}}
*{{skill icon|Mending Refrain}}
*{{skill icon|Song of Concentration}}
*{{skill icon|Song of Restoration}} ([[elite]])
*{{monster skill icon|Dormant Husk}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Erasklion's Spear]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
*Erasklion is surrounded by around 10 [[Fungal Spore]]s and two [[Poison Dart]] traps.
*Once it has been defeated, 3 groups of [[Fungal Spore]]s will spawn on the path leading to this boss.
*Reaching this boss is not necessary for the main [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks (quest)|Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest]]. It also lies in a dead-end, so there is no need to actually face this boss when going through the dungeon.
